name: grpstats
expr: m = grpstats(X, g); [m2, s2] = grpstats(X, g, {'mean', 'std'}); ms = grpstats(X, g, 'sum'); mn = grpstats(X, g, 'numel');
comment: MATLAB grpstats: per-group statistics. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on default-mean, multi-fn cell-of-strings, sum, std, numel aggregators. Other aggregators (var, sem, min, max) supported in numkit. Cell-of-fn output ordering matches MATLAB's nargout indexing. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship grpstats in core (statistics package only); reports N/A.
